name: Pasquiaornis
sum: Cenomanian hesperornithine from near Arborfield, Saskatchewan, Canada, about 95 to 93 million years old.
holotype: SMNH P2077.117, a left tarsometatarsus, with the paratype femur SMNH P2077.60.
material: Hindlimb and wing bones of two species.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Tokaryk et al. 1997

sources.text: T. T. Tokaryk, S. L. Cumbaa, and J. E. Storer. 1997. Early Late Cretaceous birds from Saskatchewan, Canada: the oldest diverse avifauna known from North America. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 17(1):172-176
